command:
set -eu
echo HOST=$(hostname)
echo USER=$USER
echo '--- worktrees ---'
git -C /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo worktree list --porcelain || true
echo '--- branch refs ---'
git -C /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo fetch origin chatgpt-work/voice-full-integration-20260912 --quiet || true
git -C /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo rev-parse origin/chatgpt-work/voice-full-integration-20260912 || true
echo '--- conversation service ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart -p Environment
echo '--- dropins ---'
systemctl --user cat frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service || true
echo '--- realtime process/ws hints ---'
ps -eo pid,etimes,args | grep -E 'voice_full_runtime|gespraechsmodus.py|realtime_gespraech.py|gpt-realtime' | grep -v grep || true
echo '--- recent voice journal ---'
journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -n 80 --no-pager || true
